invariantRules.text: A compensation band remains identifiable independently of a worker, position, assignment, payroll result and payment.
Changing range points, currency, basis, period, geography, authority or applicability creates an immutable successor version.
A band range is neither an individual assignment nor a payable.
Minimum, reference and maximum are Money amounts and each pins currency, unit or basis, period, frequency, FTE normalization and source authority.
An assignment may omit a band or be outside a cited range; off-band status is explicit and valid.
A Position may cite one band version for an effective interval, but that citation does not state occupant pay.
Grade, proficiency, performance and compensation band remain separate axes.
Compa-ratio, occupancy and position-in-range are observations and never band attributes.
A band change does not mutate assignment, payroll or payment history.
Original-currency values remain original; FX and frequency conversions are derived observations with source, direction, time and rounding.
Retirement preserves historical resolution and citations.
Missing range values are unknown, never zero.
Derived per-person or single-occupant range observations are subject to the same cohort-floor, complementary-suppression, join and repeated-query controls as aggregate disclosures.
